messages:
alex: Hey team — I addressed the review comments on #4271. Changed the batching config, added a unit test for the allocator edge case, and updated the docs section. Can someone do a quick re-check when you have a minute? @maria @jamie 🙏

maria: Thanks — I'll skim now. Any smoke test steps I should run locally?

alex: Only `make smoke` and then `curl -s http://localhost:8080/health` — added those steps to the PR description. Ran local perf, ~2% median latency delta (looked fine).

jamie: Skimming — looks sensible. Left one small nit about structured logging keys. Pushed a tiny commit renaming `debug_id` -> `request_id`.

alex: Saw that, thanks — merged the rename into the branch. CI is re-running now.

ci-bot: CI: 1/4 succeeded, 3/4 running — integration suite queued.

maria: If CI is green I can approve and we can merge during the usual canary window (20:00 UTC). Is that OK for everyone?

alex: @maria yes that window works. Note: I added a feature flag `enable_prefix_cache` defaulted to `false`. We'll flip it post-canary if no regressions.

jamie: One small ops ask: add a rollback snippet in the PR for oncall. Suggest: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --namespace=prod`

alex: Added the rollback commands to the PR body and a short checklist for SRE. Thanks.

ci-bot: CI: 4/4 passed — all checks successful. :white_check_mark:

maria: Approving now. :shipit:

sara: Heads-up: schedule merge for 20:05 UTC so SRE can get a baseline and monitor. @oncall-bot FYI.

oncall-bot: Pager duty notice sent to @sam_oncall for 20:00–21:00 UTC.

sam_oncall: I'll watch the dashboards and be ready to rollback if needed.

alex: Thanks all — merging in 10m (will post canary results).
